summary.text: Nikki Merritt, a Democrat, was elected to the Georgia State Senate in 2020, was sworn in on January 11, 2021, and serves District 9.

paragraphs.text: She spent 23 years in a career in telecommunications.
She grew up in Austell, attended Pebblebrook High School, the University of Georgia and Georgia State University, and lives in Grayson.
